extDescription.message: Dvojezično prevođenje e-pošte (original i prevod, jedan pored drugog). Google mehanizam je podrazumevano besplatan; koristite sopstveni AI model (BYOK).

optionMore.description: Divider label before the models.dev providers in the provider dropdown.

optionCustomModel.description: Dropdown option that reveals a free-text model id field.

optionReasoning.description: How much reasoning effort the AI model should spend on a translation.

optionReasoningLowest.description: Use the lowest reasoning level the selected model accepts.

optionReasoningDefault.description: Send no reasoning parameter and let the provider decide.
